title: Logic
statement: A record of the logic a person writes (a command, query or event handler, a predicate, a rule, a service, an adapter, a generator, or a runtime package and its library files) MUST carry out the behaviour of the essential record that it implements and read its inputs; a person writes it because no record of the specification states that behaviour in a form from which STEGO can derive code.

title: Storage shape
statement: A record of the storage shape a person writes (a data model, a table, a value type, a repository, a projection, a reader, an event type or a data store) MUST hold exactly the fields and keys of the essential record that it stores; a person writes it because STEGO does not yet derive it from the domain model.

title: Wiring
statement: A record of the wiring a person writes (a CLI handler, an entry point, a registry component or a tooling record) MUST connect the commands, queries and components of its domain to the interface or the build that runs them; a person writes it because STEGO does not yet derive it from the interaction design.
